title: The Crown's Call
summary: Placing the Crown of the Sovereign upon his head, Ha-Jun is pulled into an ethereal mindscape duel against the ancient consciousness of First Sovereign Asmodaius.

panels.shot: golden-violet mana column erupting from summit wide shot
panels.action: A ten-mile-wide column of celestial mana roars into the cosmos from Mount Obsidian's peak.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes rolling back as reality dissolves
panels.action: Ha-Jun sits on the throne; his irises flood with pure white light as his consciousness is ripped inward.

panels.shot: tae-jun reaching out in panic
panels.action: Tae-Jun rushes up the steps: 'Ha-Jun! Crown ko resist karo! Apne dimaag ko chhodna mat!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: HA-JUN!! APNA MIND CONTROL MAT KHONA!!

panels.shot: mindscape chamber: the hall of black mirrors
panels.action: Ha-Jun finds himself standing on an endless sea of black glass under a sky of swirling red nebulas.

panels.shot: titanic 100-foot shadowy emperor looming overhead
panels.action: Sitting on an ethereal throne of swords: the colossal shadow of the First Sovereign, Lord Asmodaius.

panels.shot: asmodaius glowing four crimson eyes looking down
panels.action: Four burning crimson eyes glare down like dying stars: 'A fragile human vessel dares put my crown upon his head?!'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: TUM SIRF MERI WAAPSI KA VESSEL HO! APNI BODY MUJHE SURRENDER KARO!

panels.shot: black shadow tendrils wrapping around ha-jun legs
panels.action: Dark shadow tendrils erupt from the glass floor, creeping up Ha-Jun's jeans and jacket like liquid tar.

panels.shot: ha-jun struggling against the mental possession
panels.action: Ha-Jun grits his teeth; his temples throb with veins as ancient memories flood his cortex.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh meri memories ko erase karne ki koshish kar raha hai... Mera naam, mera bachpan!

panels.shot: memories of school bullying flashing in fragments
panels.action: Shards of memory: bullies kicking him in the classroom, rain on the academy roof, feeling helpless.

panels.shot: asmodaius mocking ha-jun past weakness
panels.action: Asmodaius booms: 'See how weak you were! A cowering insect beaten by mortal children!'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: Tum kamzor the, aur hamesha kamzor rahoge! Let a real God rule!

panels.shot: ha-jun remembering his brother's smile
panels.action: In the center of the dark glass, a golden memory shines: Kang Tae-Jun holding umbrella over 10yo Ha-Jun in the rain.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Nahi... Main kamzor tha, lekin main akela nahi tha. Mere bhai ne mere liye apni zindagi di.

panels.shot: ha-jun clenching fists in the mindscape
panels.action: Ha-Jun plants his boots firmly on the glass; a shockwave of his own crimson-violet mana blasts outward.

panels.shot: shadow tendrils shattering into glass fragments
panels.action: The dark possession tendrils around his legs snap and shatter like brittle ice.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting the sanguine fang in his mental grip
panels.action: Ha-Jun draws The Sanguine Fang, blazing with violet hellfire inside his own soul plane.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up fearlessly at 100-foot emperor
panels.action: A 17-year-old high school student staring down a 100-foot primordial demon god without blinking.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum hazaaron saal pehle mar chuke ho, Asmodaius. Yeh era mera hai.

panels.shot: asmodaius roaring in insulted fury
panels.action: The giant phantom emperor raises a 50-foot blade of shadow darkness to crush Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping 100 feet straight up in the mindscape
panels.action: Ha-Jun rockets upward, his shadow wings leaving a contrail of violet starlight through the nebulas.

panels.shot: asmodaius shadow blade slamming down
panels.action: The giant blade smashes the glass floor beneath Ha-Jun, sending infinite mirror shards into the sky.

panels.shot: ha-jun running up the length of asmodaius blade
panels.action: Ha-Jun sprints directly up the flat of the giant descending sword, moving at Mach 2.

panels.shot: ha-jun reaching asmodaius forehead crown
panels.action: Ha-Jun arrives at the giant shadow's brow, right before the phantom crown of horns.

panels.shot: ha-jun driving the sanguine fang into the phantom crown
panels.action: Ha-Jun plunges his flaming blood katana straight into the center of Asmodaius's forehead.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: MAIN VESSEL NAHI HOON! MAIN SOVEREIGN HOON!!

panels.shot: asmodaius colossal form cracking with golden light
panels.action: Spiderweb fractures of blinding golden light spread across the 100-foot titan's body.

panels.shot: asmodaius voice shifting from wrath to stunned awe
panels.action: The primordial voice echoes with profound reverence: 'Unbending will... You truly surpass me, boy.'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: Tum sach mein mere throne ke laayak ho... Rule wisely, Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: asmodaius dissolving into pure golden mana shower
panels.action: The giant dissolves into millions of golden star-particles, washing into Ha-Jun's soul like liquid gold.

panels.shot: mindscape dissolving back into the physical throne room
panels.action: The starry nebulas fade; the physical summit of Mount Obsidian crystallizes back into view.

panels.shot: ha-jun opening eyes with full sovereign majesty
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes open: royal violet irises circled by double crimson eclipse rings and swirling stars.

panels.shot: the crown of the sovereign settling perfectly on his brow
panels.action: The obsidian-and-ruby crown glows with peaceful, subservient violet luminescence atop his black hair.

panels.shot: tae-jun kneeling on the throne steps in tears of relief
panels.action: Tae-Jun drops to his knees on the marble steps, exhaling a choked sob: 'Usne kar dikhaya... He conquered the Crown!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... Tumne Asmodaius ko subjugate kar liya!

panels.shot: kuro bowing deeply on the throne armrest
panels.action: Kuro presses his forehead to the black star-matter armrest: 'Hail Ha-Jun Kang. True Demon Sovereign of the Abyss.'

panels.shot: ha-jun standing from the throne, sovereign domain expanding
panels.action: Ha-Jun rises; a 500-meter spherical domain of royal violet mana expands outward around Mount Obsidian.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: This realm belongs to me now.
